name: BUG
description: An error or regression in expected behavior.

name: EPIC
description: A container for a group of related issues.

name: ERRATA
description: A mistake in documentation or other content.

name: FEATURE
description: An idea for a new or improved operation or behavior.

name: INCIDENT
description: An event that unexpectedly disrupted or degraded production services.

name: MAINTENANCE
description: A routine housekeeping chore, eg. documentation edits.

name: REFACTORING
description: A way to redesign code to improve the developer experience.

name: RUNTIME
description: A change to a constraint within which the system must perform at runtime.

name: SPIKE
description: An investigation, prototype, or other feasibility study.

name: STYLE
description: Code formatting, whitespace, indentation, or code style improvements.

name: TASK
description: A miscellaneous unit of work, not easily categorized.
